messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired: INC12345 - high error rate / hung streaming requests in canary - paging oncall rotation
pagerduty: page sent to @oncall_jamie (urgent)
oncall_jamie: Acked. I'm on it. :rotating_light:
sre_lead_maya: I'm joining — what's the scope? Any customer impact?
oncall_jamie: Canary fraction ~5% of traffic to eu-west-1; alerts show p99 streaming latency ~30s and a bunch of stuck connections. Some 502s after client timeouts.
eng_runtime_tom: Seeing lots of stuck streams on canary hosts. KV client miss spikes followed by eviction loops. Quick tail of logs: 
```
stream-handler: waiting for kv fetch timeout
kvclient: request_id=abcd1234 timeout after 5000ms
```
support_oliver: Support reports 12 customer sessions affected so far — small count but high severity for those customers (real-time features degraded).
sre_lead_maya: Immediate plan: (1) divert canary traffic to stable model, (2) kill hung streams and drain, (3) if unstable, rollback the canary image.
eng_runtime_tom: Can flip routing for canary group to stable via traffic config in ~2m. Also can push a targeted cache purge to canary hosts to clear possible stale pointers. Purge command: 
```
redwoodctl cache purge --selector=canary --key-prefix=stream_kv --force
```
oncall_jamie: Doing traffic diversion now. @eng_runtime_tom please confirm when purge started.
eng_runtime_tom: Purge started. Tailing logs — stuck stream count dropping from 320 -> 45 in the first minute.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC12345 acknowledged by oncall_jamie; escalation suspended.
product_ana: Any customer-visible degradation numbers? ETA to stable routing?
oncall_jamie: TL;DR: Affected ~0.4% of global requests during the spike, concentrated in eu-west-1 streaming sessions. Diversion finished in ~3m, purge took ~90s. Keeping rollback as fallback.
support_oliver: Reached out to the two impacted enterprise contacts with an initial note and will follow up once postmortem is written.
sre_lead_maya: Follow-ups: collect detailed KV client metrics, add guardrail for eviction storms, add earlier canary healthcheck that triggers diversion at lower thresholds. Assigning owners.
eng_runtime_tom: Root cause hypothesis: cache invalidation race introduced in the canary image that left pointers to evicted entries, causing blocking KV fetches and downstream stream stalls. Will bisect the release branch and prepare a rollback PR if needed.
oncall_jamie: Closing active paging for now. I'll stay on call and monitor until metrics are stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: mitigated — monitoring. Postmortem assigned to eng_runtime_tom and sre_lead_maya.
product_ana: Please add customer-impact notes and timeline to the postmortem. We'll coordinate customer comms after draft.
